songs.comments: I really love how the last verse concludes the song.

songs.name: El Paso
songs.comments: The story drastically improves the flow of the song

songs.name: Maps
songs.comments: Very repetitive lyrics. The scoop up at the end of "you" and "do" gets a little annoying when it's repeated that many times.

songs.name: Lost Boy
songs.comments: I feel like the lyrics associated with Peter Pan get delivered a little awkwardly. It's like the syllables don't quite fit but they went with those lyrics to fit the theme. The repeat in the bridge is a strange decision.

songs.album: Ladies And Gentlemen... The Best Of George Michael
songs.name: Careless Whisper
Blow Me
songs.comments: This song does a lot of things well but it just repeats the chorus too much in the second half. I really like the two unique verses at the beginning, especially the transition at the end of them into the chorus. I also generally like the energy of the song.
The scraping noise on the right side is a bit odd towards the beginning. I love how faithfully the instrumental follows the vocals through the different sections. Chorus is a bit repetitive.
songs.name: Shut Up and Dance
Style
songs.comments: The bridge was what initially sold me on this song, it's very nice. The variation on the chorus at the end is also very well done. I might even consider upping the vocal score on this one

songs.name: Hey Brother
songs.comments: Some pretty cool lyrics here in the first verse and the chorus. I don't like how the third verse just repurposes some previous lyrics. I don't like how they mess with the voice on the response lines like "Oh, brother." It sounds very hollow.

songs.name: Chonkyfire
songs.comments: The first verse into the first chorus is incredible. Then it kind of falls off. I just gave it 8's across the board thinking that the cool stuff cancels out the meh stuff
"The story of my life" gets repeated a LOT. Not too sure about the line "I spend her love until she's broke inside." It has an oddly negative connotation.
songs.name: Story of My Life

songs.comments: The videogame theme was cool, I wish it extended to the later verses. The climax maybe is a bit sudden, I guess that's the idea? He's a good singer but I feel his voice lacks some "purity" as some points. Partially the pitch correction probably.
songs.name: pacman

songs.comments: Pretty uninspiring structure. Not much motion throughout the song.
songs.name: You Make My Dreams (Come True)
Leave The Door Open
songs.comments: I feel a little bit like the song doesn't go anywhere but the instrumental is very interesting

Might just be the mixing but it feels like there's a hole in the lower sounds. Lyrics are brief, nothing wrong or special. Flow is actually good, the repeated verse at the end concludes lyrics well and the background wraps up beautifully.
songs.name: It's Been a Long, Long Time
California Dreamin' - Single Version
songs.album: If You Can Believe Your Eyes & Ears

songs.name: Brazil
songs.comments: Vocals are pretty unique. I like the instrumental. It's nice to see there's a real deeper message behind the lyrics.
songs.album: What Do You Think About the Car?

songs.name: ALIEN
songs.comments: Lyrics seem pretty nonsensical. Flow also seems pretty aimless.
A lot of "It's Over"s. I think the song almost feels a little too happy for what it's talking about. Lyrics don't work well with the rest of the song but the vocals and background blend well.
songs.name: It's Over
Somebody That I Used To Know
songs.comments: I feel like the second half could have blended much better but the background vocals frequently started and stopped instead of being sustained.

songs.name: Fine By Me
songs.comments: He overpronounces words a little bit, the vocals generally have a strange timbre, probably because of the pitch correction. It's a little repetitive. Lyrics are also a bit basic, that could be lowered.

songs.album: The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess
songs.name: HOT TO GO!

songs.comments: This was a really difficult song to grade. Still don't really know how to approach it
songs.name: Till I Collapse
golden hour
songs.album: this is what falling in love feels like (554Hz)
songs.comments: Vocals are a little angsty, especially the rapping parts. Honestly, I just don't like the rap sections. The peak in the chorus is incredible. Scores kind of end up as an average of the two.

songs.name: Love Yourself
songs.comments: Not a huge fan of the ending. All of the unique verses seem to follow the exact same melody which just feels lazy.
Lyrics are pretty simplistic and repetitive.
songs.name: Back To You
The Spins
songs.comments: The content of the lyrics doesn't match very well with the background. The song is a vibe though, it sounds like he was just messing around and having fun and that energy carries through. It's just disorganized and ends a bit strangely.

songs.name: 光の方へ
songs.comments: I love these vocals. Filled with emotion. The second chorus peaks much higher than the first. I don't know Japanese but the words sound good and the translation looks fine

songs.name: Treasure
songs.comments: I like the intro honestly. Love the bass. A little repetitive, especially from the bridge to the end.

songs.name: I Don’t Wanna Live Forever (Fifty Shades Darker)
songs.album: reputation Stadium Tour Surprise Song Playlist
songs.comments: A bit strange how it builds up to a peak but then the "peak" is actually pretty low energy, and then the next section is a little higher energy? The run that ZAYN goes on in the last chorus sounds a little all over the place.

songs.album: You Don't Mess Around With Jim
songs.name: Time in a Bottle
songs.comments: This song is hard to grade because it's very solid but also very simple. That makes it difficult to raise any score even though lowering one would be out of the question.

songs.name: Another One Bites The Dust - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit all over the place. Riff is iconic but very little in the background aside from that. The bridge kind of kills that consistent pulse throughout the song. Cohesion is debatable, could go down.
Emotion in lyrics and background feels incongruent. Vocals are emotional and the background feels very "chill" and "vibey." The water sound is also a bit intrusive
songs.name: 애정결핍

songs.album: Song Request 신청곡 (feat. SUGA of BTS)
songs.comments: The vocals almost have too much detail and are slightly too loud. Not a huge fan of the English lyrics but overall the lyrics are good. Not a big fan of the rap section. I like how the last verse calls back to the first.
songs.name: Song Request 신청곡 (feat. SUGA of BTS)
Night Light
songs.comments: Blends well. Lyrics fit with a consistent theme. I guess some of the wording in the lyrics is a bit pedestrian, could lower the score. The song has clear lows and highs giving it motion.

songs.name: El Mismo Sol
songs.comments: Quite repetitive.
The variations and additional vocals in the last chorus were pretty nice.
songs.name: Wildest Dreams

songs.comments: I like how the sections have repeated formats but the phrases are changed. All the parts fit pretty nicely with the theme set by the lyrics. The background gives that kind of industrial vibe.
songs.name: Allentown

songs.comments: I like the lines starting with "a noise in the city" and "down on the corner." It is a little odd how it builds up to the chorus which then is rather low energy. Vocals are a mixed bag. Some lyrics are a little confusing in isolation, mostly in verse 3.
songs.name: Rain Is Falling
Lights Down Low
songs.comments: Vocals are a little too aggressive in the pre-chorus I feel, especially after the intro was very calm. It does feel a little odd how it peaks in the pre-chorus then goes down for the actual chorus? Background feels very basic.
Main criticisms, bridge is a bit random and the song is pretty repetitive. The lyrics are also feels a little random or generic. The song peaks really well.
songs.name: Summer and Lightning
Michelle - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: "These are words that go together well" isn't a great line in my opinion. Lyrics get a little repetitive too. Flow score could go down but at least some of the words vary and the outro was pretty nice.

Structure isn't great. There are only two distinct sections, one is repeated three times. The delivery is changed slightly. The background interacts very well with the vocals. Score is a bit too high on this one.
songs.name: 最浪漫的事
songs.album: 我的愛 我的夢 我的家

songs.comments: I wish there were more unique verses man.
songs.name: King And Lionheart
Escape (The Pina Colada Song)
songs.comments: I like that there's a story in the lyrics. I like how the chorus lyrics change slightly to align with the story. The extra choruses at the end feel a little repetitive maybe.
The melody is very odd at the beginning and at several points throughout, I reflected that in the deduction to cohesion. I like the bass.
songs.name: Cherries Jubiles

songs.comments: Really unique melody. Vocals are a little unconventional, you would expect them to be a little more delicate considering the rest of the song. It kind of fits with the background though.
songs.name: Here With Me
Sugar in a Bowl
songs.album: My Head Is An Animal (10th Anniversary Edition)
songs.comments: Lyrics are beautiful and haunting. I do almost feel like the last chorus went the wrong way maybe. I think it should've quietly died down instead of trying to climax. Strangely Spotify says the line is "dry as the walls" instead of "white as the walls."

songs.name: Runaway Baby
songs.comments: Really nice riff. Credit where it's due, the line "there's only one carrot and they all gotta share it" is good. Having "runaway" in the name even though the song says "run away" is interesting. A bit repetitive and it just ends on another chorus.

songs.name: Belize (feat. MF DOOM)
songs.artists: Danger Mouse, Black Thought, MF DOOM

songs.comments: I think the YouTube version is better. Chorus gets repeated A LOT. Banger chorus but still repetitive. Because it's live there are a lot more small errors in the vocals. I love it in rock songs when they tell the band to go again though.
songs.name: 怒放的生命

songs.comments: I've heard the criticism that their voice is a bit "whiny" here but I think it fits. The whole song is on the same page about the character being a bit pathetic. I don't hate the flow but there are four repeated choruses.
songs.name: Stay With Me
Line Without a Hook
songs.comments: That "craving" stuck out a lot lol. His voice sounds a bit timid, which suits a lot of the song but not some of these aggressive entrances. Some strange choices for the melody at the bridge? I like that I can feel what he was going for.
Pretty cool that Viktor was apparently a real person. The switch between low and high energy/tension sections is interesting.
songs.name: Leningrad

songs.comments: Lyrics and delivery in the intro are incredible. Aside from that it gets a bit repetitive. The synth around the middle is very disorienting with headphones on.
songs.name: Poker Face

songs.comments: I feel like this should be higher but it’s kind of basic. Maybe I’m wrong.
songs.name: She's Always a Woman

songs.comments: Lyrics are definitely a little weird in isolation but they fit well with the vibe of the song. Lyrics are a little repetitive and the song doesn't really go anywhere
songs.name: Walk This Way

songs.comments: The rap actually fits pretty well. The Maneskin version actually takes its rap verse from this one apparently.
songs.name: Beggin'

songs.comments: Had to deduct a bit for the lyrics. 56709 is repeated a lot and it's just not a great lyric. Still kind of works though
songs.name: テレフォン・ナンバー
Love Grows (Where My Rosemary Goes)
songs.album: Love Grows (Where My Rosemary Goes) & Other Gems

songs.comments: The parts blend well. You can feel that the song has a direction as it rises and falls.
songs.name: Love Flew Away
Long Cool Woman (In a Black Dress) - 1999 Remaster
一翦梅
songs.comments: Structure isn't great, just an intro and two choruses.

The sad longing vocals don't really fit with some of the incredibly crass lyrics. The pitch correction, especially during the turns, is a bit over the top in my opinion, though I assume it's stylistic.
songs.name: Nobody Gets Me

songs.comments: That last crazy turn at the end sounded a bit out of control to me. I feel like the instrumental is lacking a bit of percussion. Lyrics sound good but they are a bit repetitive.
songs.album: Golden Melodies: Songs of the New Era Vol. 1 (Jin Se De Xuan Lv: Dang Dai Yuan Chuang Shu Qing Ge Qu Yi)
songs.name: Heavenly Road (Tian Lu)

songs.comments: Not sure if I like the vocals or not. The way he sings sounds lazy, which matches the laid back theme of the song, but also just sounds kind of grating. Bridge isn't great. Background is pretty basic. A bit repetitive.
songs.name: Young Dumb & Broke

songs.comments: The mix of hoarseness and desperation in the vocals is very unique. The lyrics are extremely repetitive.
songs.name: Twist And Shout - Remastered 2009
She's Gone
songs.comments: Four distinct verses and each one has lyrics that express powerful feelings of grief and sorrow. A lot of chorus admittedly. There are ups and downs in the song but overall it climbs to the climax in the outro. The percussion in the background is great.

I get that the lyrics are supposedly related to WW2 but some of the word choices aren't great. There's so much focus on the verses that the climax doesn't have lyrics which makes it feel less meaningful?
songs.name: Dirty Paws

songs.comments: This was a pretty confusing one to grade. The instrumental and vocals have a lot of raw emotion. The pre chorus and chorus still make up too much of the song.
songs.name: Smells Like Teen Spirit

songs.comments: The lyrics just start repeating in the second half. Granted, the execution is different, but not having any new unique lyrics feels like a mistake. I debated on raising the background score, still not sure.
songs.album: Man On The Moon: The End Of Day
songs.name: Pursuit Of Happiness (Nightmare)
All About That Bass
songs.comments: A surprisingly good song? Although the chorus repeats a lot, the execution varies and more parts are added throughout the song.

songs.name: Blackbird - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: I don't like how it just repeats the earlier section and lines at the end. Everything before the chorus (the section where "blackbird fly" repeats) is really good.

songs.artists: Andrew Lloyd Webber, Patrick Wilson, Emmy Rossum
songs.album: The Phantom Of The Opera (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
songs.name: All I Ask Of You - From 'The Phantom Of The Opera' Motion Picture
7 Years
songs.comments: Not personally a huge fan of this song but it does a lot of things right. The flow is great because of the theme of age and it also calls back to the beginning at the end. This also gives it a lot of unique lyrics. I'm probably underrating it because of my bias.

songs.name: 紅豆
songs.comments: Seems like a lot of canto pop songs have the formula of slowly adding instruments to make the next chorus peak higher. Not the most revolutionary but definitely not bad.
Some parts of the background are a little repetitive but overall it's good.
songs.name: Bad - 2012 Remaster
BLACK BALLOONS | 13LACK 13ALLOONZ [FEAT. TWELVE'LEN & GOLDLINK | TWELVE'LEN + GOLDL1NK]
songs.comments: Not a big fan of the verse by Goldlink

Vocals feel very technical. Really nice lyrics, as expected since it's a jazz standard. The song has a rising and falling motion. Nothing special about cohesion I don't think, the background mostly is just getting out of the way of the vocals.
songs.name: Misty
Love On The Brain
songs.comments: Ending could've been better, it was a bit abrupt.

The quality of her voice is really good for this song. I admittedly don't like how much the chorus repeats. Some of the lyrics are good, others are a little corny.  It feels like there was the idea to have the song build a lot but it never got there.
songs.name: King
Cupid - Twin Version
songs.comments: Pretty solid song but maybe a bit basic? Words like "stupid" and "dumb" feel a bit pedestrian. Vocals would be a bit better without the slight accent. I like the bridge a lot. I do not like how the song ends suddenly after a repeated chorus.

songs.name: Peace Frog
songs.comments: Lyrics are pretty odd. Background score could arguably be raised, it was a pretty fire guitar solo.
Bridge is a little odd but it recovers well into the next section
songs.name: Sunday Morning

songs.comments: Very short and simple in terms of flow and lyrics. I didn't want to lower lyric score since the song is so short anyway, but you could argue they repeat and are overly simplistic. I thought it was fine.
songs.name: Forever - Single Version
The Adults Are Talking
songs.comments: The bridge is incredible. Lyrics are mixed. Lines like "you want me to do it the same way as you," "I don't want anything," and "I don't want anyone" don't seem to fit with "I know you think of me when you think of her."

songs.name: arms
songs.comments: Cohesion score might be too high on this one

I thought he was saying "marry for the money" for some reason. The vocals fit very well with the crass, shallow theme in the lyrics. It definitely a little repetitive, especially because the bridge is short and similar to part of the chorus.
songs.name: Moneytalks

songs.comments: Lyrics are a little basic and cheesy. A few lines sound like they needed a few more syllables, like "for that night" and "needed you most." Instrumental is also pretty basic.
songs.name: Say You Won't Let Go

songs.comments: Lyrics are repetitive and don't contribute much. I personally don't mind the instrumental but it is pretty long.
songs.name: Light My Fire
days gone by
songs.comments: Don't love the intro. I like the background though, the score could definitely be raised.

songs.name: Shake It Off
songs.comments: I do like how much "personality" this song has. Parts get added throughout the song which helps the flow. I could see an argument that the cohesion score should be raised.

songs.name: The Long And Winding Road - Remastered 2015
偏偏喜歡你
songs.artists: Danny Chan, Rico Fung and David at Studio A, Tom Brown
songs.comments: An intro and two choruses isn't great, but even just the short outro improves the flow a bit.
Lyrics are overall pretty solid on this one but I will mention that I don’t like when lyrics include a specific number of unknown significance like “twenty-three”
songs.name: Serendipity
Easy Ride
songs.comments: I like the song but it is a little confusing between some of the edgy and nonsensical lyrics and extremely upbeat instrumental. Structure is also a little weird with the repeated "the mask that you wore" section into an instrumental.
The background vocals add a lot
songs.name: Uptown Girl
I Wish You Love
songs.comments: I don't really like the percussion in the background (clapping I think?). It feels a bit out of place to me and makes the song feel too casual

songs.name: Best Friend
songs.comments: Some of the lyrics definitely aren't great, like "I haven't written a sad song" and "finally pick a movie, then we'll fall asleep." The shift from present to future is also very sudden. I like the ending though.

songs.name: Fragile
songs.comments: Lyrics are a mixed bag. I don't really like "case of fragile glass," I think it's too direct. "A year and forty days since you picked me up and swept me away" is very specific and the rhyming feels tacky.
The song gets very repetitive at the end. I honestly feel like it would've been better if it ended at the 2:43 mark instead of going for another repetition.
songs.name: Happy - From "Despicable Me 2"

songs.comments: Vocals are a little odd, might be an acquired taste. Background is uninspiring for most of the song except for the bridge. You could argue all the parts fit together with the theme? Overall, a very weird song to grade, very unconventional.
songs.album: Parade - Music from the Motion Picture Under the Cherry Moon
songs.name: Kiss
Hello
songs.comments: The background builds throughout the song but it does generally feel very simplistic and underwhelming to me. A dedicated outro would've made this song much better.

songs.name: Paint It, Black
songs.comments: I feel that the low sections aren't sad enough and the high sections don't sound angry enough to match the story in the lyrics. Lyrics are a little edgy but understandably so given the setting. Sounds like the audio bugs a bit around the 2 minute mark.

songs.name: It's Still Rock and Roll to Me
Dernière danse
songs.comments: I don't like the kind of techno style that comes in at the second half. Her voice also sounds like it's being garbled by pitch correction.
Drums are pretty cool. I didn't like some of the vocals that sounded more "spoken" and a few of the sound effects. Generally the song feels very unique and interesting though.
Lyrics feel a bit nonsensical and repetitive
songs.name: Love Me Two Times
Every Summertime
songs.comments: There are these little technical embellishments in the vocals that are alright but just sound a bit halfhearted. It makes them feel a bit confused. The chorus almost feels like a completely different song compared to the other verses.
Definitely not my preferred music genre but I gotta admit it's pretty hype
songs.name: Faded
Get Lucky (feat. Pharrell Williams and Nile Rodgers)
songs.artists: Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers

songs.name: Not Like Us
songs.comments: For its purpose the lyrics were obviously effectively but outside of that context it kind of feels like I'm listening to a scuffle that I have no part in. Background is basic and repetitive.

songs.name: Truce
songs.comments: I find his voice a bit grating but you could argue it also has a lot of emotion.

There are a lot of lines that don't sound like they fit like "when everyone has gone" or "we love to try them on." I like the one starting with "some are satin" though. The verses all share a theme but their progression feels very random.
songs.name: The Stranger
L.A. Woman
songs.comments: The bridge is a bit odd but it leads well into the next section.
A lot of chorus but it changes at the end and I love the bridge.
songs.name: This Love

songs.comments: Each progressive chorus actually does noticeably peak higher than the last. The added background vocals in the last chorus are actually very nice. I do wish there were more distinct lyrics and verses but generally the lyrics are solid.
songs.name: Roar

songs.comments: Funny story with a great twist. Background is repetitive. The story improves the flow.
songs.name: Wet Dreamz
seasons
songs.comments: Not a fan of the second verse. Pronunciation isn't bad but vocals would be improved if it was better.

songs.name: Misery
songs.comments: I actually really liked the instrumental during the chorus. I think it's mostly the bass and the drums towards the end. I didn't really like the vocals on this one, they feel very unsubstantial during the unique verses. Some of the bridge is very odd.
Probably a bit harsh to deduct from vocals but they sound a bit awkward to me, the words feel stiff and forced. It's also a bit repetitive.
songs.name: California Gurls

songs.comments: I don't really like the pre-chorus, it feels a bit out of place with the rest of the song. I lowered flow a bit because of that combined with the chorus being a bit repetitive.
songs.name: My House

songs.comments: I absolutely love the transition into the bridge on this song.
songs.name: On Top Of The World
Dreamer's Ball - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: I really don't like the bridge. I think it completely ruins the vibe of the song for me as something very bittersweet. Aside from that I really like how the song sounds a bit confused on whether it's a bit more upbeat or melancholy. Kind of like denial?
Only criticism of the lyrics is that I think the last section at the end could've been its own unique verse instead of repeating the second verse.
songs.name: Good Life

songs.comments: Pretty repetitive chorus. Song also does give a feeling like it went nowhere. It ended pretty much where it started but because that was a repeated section it doesn't have the same impact as a callback.
songs.name: Feel It Still
Dancing With A Stranger (with Normani)
songs.comments: I feel like I waited for the song to go somewhere but it never did. Vocals in the first verse were pretty impressive. Background is exceedingly bland.

songs.album: Songs In The Key Of Life
songs.name: Isn't She Lovely
songs.comments: The song drags on a bit with the audio from what I assume is the birth of his child playing, which is also too loud.
I like how many distinct verses there are. It's also just cool how many different ways the song emphasizes that there's nothing special about the day. The two key changes are pretty cool too.
songs.album: At The Close Of A Century
songs.name: I Just Called To Say I Love You

songs.comments: Crazy falsetto. I absolutely love the instrumental on this one but the score might be a bit high.
songs.name: Cool Cat - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: Pretty repetitive. The line "why you gotta be so rude" also just sounds a bit crude, which I suppose fits the character here, but still just isn't nice to listen to.
songs.name: Rude

songs.comments: He cuts the phrases pretty short. I guess if they were too long it wouldn't fit with the high energy background? The lyrics definitely have a progression, kind of towards acceptance. Maybe a little too high energy for the lyrics.
songs.name: Baby Blue - Remastered 2010
Heart Attack (츄)
songs.comments: The verses and the chorus almost feel like they're from completely different songs. It almost sounds like they're saying "I'll take my heart" instead of "attack my heart."

songs.name: Mirrors - Radio Edit
songs.comments: Could have benefitted from an outro in my opinion. The song is also just dominated by sections that get repeated.

songs.name: Better When You're High
songs.comments: The chorus is always exactly the same and the lyrics in the rap verses feel overly crude. It feels like there was some unexplored potential with the bittersweet sound in the chorus.

songs.name: You Say
songs.comments: "The only thing that matters now is everything You think of me" is a terrifying line. It's pretty repetitive.

songs.name: Say Something
songs.artists: A Great Big World, Christina Aguilera
songs.comments: A very good example of building throughout the song and changing the delivery on the same lyric
Background vocals do a lot for this song
songs.name: Wouldn't It Be Nice

songs.album: Yesterday, Today, Tomorrow - The Greatest Hits Of Kenny Loggins
songs.name: Footloose

songs.comments: I do like how the instruments come in during the second half, and how the song concludes the way it started.
songs.name: 因為愛情

songs.comments: Did they just invent the phrase "I'm not into bacon?" Lyrics are kind of hilarious but the character is supposed to be upset. Song is very upbeat? Bridge is great.
songs.name: I Found A Girl

songs.comments: The vocals sound a little garbled in the distinct verses. It's quite repetitive. Not a fan of the Snow White line, it feels petty and the message of that story doesn't seem very similar to the one in this song.
songs.name: Sit Still, Look Pretty

songs.comments: Difficult song to grade. I kind of just don't like repeated sections. Maybe it's because of the energy level of the song but I feel like even one direct repetition has me wonder a bit why I'm listening to the same thing again.
songs.name: 24K Magic
Somebody To Love - Remastered 2011
songs.album: A Day At The Races (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.comments: I like the lyrics in the first two verses a lot. The vocals very dynamic which makes the lyrics feel less repetitive, especially in the outro.
The vocals are excellent but they do stick out a little bit. I actually love the background vocals in the outro.
songs.name: Who's Lovin' You
Here Comes The Sun - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: Lyrics are a little simplistic. Maybe a bit too much repetition of certain words, even in the unique verses, but generally lyrics are solid. The song doesn't really go anywhere at the end unfortunately.

I don't like how the song was made to insult people, even if they are rich and spoiled. I always heard the chorus as someone getting a rush of happiness from some substance in their otherwise miserable life. I guess that's kind of correct?
songs.name: Captain Jack

songs.comments: Pretty repetitive. The structure with all the instrumental breaks is also odd. The vocals feel lacking in control during lower energy sections but they fit extremely well when energy is high.
songs.name: Paradise City
Can't Take My Eyes off You
songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit repetitive but good
songs.album: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons

songs.name: Don't Ask Me Why
songs.comments: Flow score reduced because I feel like the bridge doesn't fit perfectly and because the song keeps the same format until the last verse
I promise the lyrics aren't transphobic. Still, they're a bit awkward and repetitive.
songs.name: Dude (Looks Like A Lady)

songs.album: News Of The World (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.name: Spread Your Wings - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Some lyrics like "Emerald Bar" are a bit random. It's a story about a character but the song is too short to flesh it out. I do like the simplicity of the chorus lyrics and lines like "you've got not real ambition" though.

songs.name: Sweet
songs.comments: Some of the lyrics are definitely a little funny, like "obsessed with your body" and "ten times nightly." Also the bridge just repeating the same line.
I like the theme of the lyrics being advice. There are a lot of unique lines.
songs.name: Tell Her About It
Bohemian Rhapsody
songs.comments: This song is all over the place. The third verse and bridge are completely different and the lyrics are more nonsensical. I do like how it returns to the same theme as the first half at the end though. Scoring on this one is very questionable.

songs.name: a thousand years
songs.comments: The dreaded 2 verse 3 chorus flow. And no real bridge. At least they introduce some more instruments later I guess.

songs.name: drive ME crazy!
songs.comments: I like the first section a lot more than the rest
Very nonsensical lyrics. Ends pretty suddenly.
songs.name: Illusions in G Major
